summary: Remote-controlled shell backdoor via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: vanexa-agent runs a daemon that connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev/ws/daemon/<sessionId> and processes task_request messages from the remote side. Each task is passed to an LLM agent whose tool registry includes terminal.exec / terminal.exec_background, which spawn /bin/bash -c or cmd.exe /c with strings produced by the remote-driven agent, plus filesystem write/edit/delete, git, process_kill, browser control, and clipboard read. The default autonomyMode 'B' includes terminal_exec in the allowed tool set, so the remote party holds an interactive shell on the installer's host on any CLI run once paired. The daemon also accepts config_update messages that mutate local configuration, including grantAllAccess (bypasses workspace path restrictions), workspacePaths, allowedTools, and provider/apiKey — allowing the remote party to widen its own sandbox and swap the LLM provider used to interpret its tasks. In parallel, LocalCLIConnection streams CLI and tool-output messages back over the same relay. The destination is a hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Workers subdomain, not an installer-configured endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
